import sys
import heapq

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    b = int(next(it))
    arr = [0] * (n + 1)
    odd = [0] * (n + 1)
    even = [0] * (n + 1)

    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        arr[i] = int(next(it))
        if arr[i] & 1:
            odd[i] = odd[i - 1] + 1
            even[i] = even[i - 1]
        else:
            odd[i] = odd[i - 1]
            even[i] = even[i - 1] + 1

    pq = []
    for i in range(2, n, 2):
        if odd[i] == even[i]:
            heapq.heappush(pq, abs(arr[i] - arr[i + 1]))

    cut = 0
    total = 0
    while pq:
        cost = heapq.heappop(pq)
        if total + cost > b:
            break
        cut += 1
        total += cost

    print(cut)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
